"import cadquery as cq

# Sketch plane: YZ. Local sketch coords (u, v) map to global (0, u, v):
# local u -> global +Y, local v -> global +Z.
P = cq.Plane.named("YZ")


def pt(u, v):
    """Convert local sketch coordinates (mm) to a global 3D point on the YZ plane."""
    return P.toWorldCoords((u, v))


# Chain vertices (local sketch coordinates, mm)
A = pt(-13, -19)
B = pt(-32, -19)
C = pt(-32, -37)
D = pt(-43, -37)
E = pt(-43, -49)

# Exactly the 4 required line entities (open chain, consecutive endpoints coincident)
segments = [
    (A, B),  # Line from (-13, -19) to (-32, -19)
    (B, C),  # Line from (-32, -19) to (-32, -37)
    (C, D),  # Line from (-32, -37) to (-43, -37)
    (D, E),  # Line from (-43, -37) to (-43, -49)
]

edges = [cq.Edge.makeLine(p0, p1) for p0, p1 in segments]

assert len(edges) == 4, "Must contain exactly 4 curve entities"

# Open chain: first start != last end (no closed profile)
assert (A.x, A.y, A.z) != (E.x, E.y, E.z), "Chain must remain open"

# Export the compound of edges (no solids, no extra geometry)
cq.exporters.export(cq.Compound.makeCompound(edges), "sketch.step")"
